content: The EthIfPhysController and EthIf- Transceiver shall always refer to the same bus type: If EthIfPhysCon- troller refers to an EthIfEthCtrlRef , EthIfTransceiver shall refer to a EthIfEthTrcvRef . If EthIfPhysController refers to an EthIfWEthCtrlRef , EthIfTransceiver shall refer to a EthIfWEthTrcvRef . If EthIfPhysCon- troller refers to an EthIfCanXLCtrlRef , EthIfTransceiver shall refer to a EthIfCanXLTrcvRef .
